races.desc: Dwarves are the hardy stout folk of the realm who pride themselves on their achievements and craftsmanship while valuing Heritage, Family, and Tradition. There are three different kinds of Dwarves; the Mountain Dwarves who have carved stone hall from the very earth of their great mountains and have even built entire city's within them, They pride themselves on their Craftsmanship and living by their Clan's code above all. The Hill Dwarves, that despite living in the valley value community above all, and often find themselves neighbored with the Halfling folk and have developed a pension for brewing stout ales, living off the land, and cooking bountiful feasts for whichever occasion. The Gold Dwarves, are the most independent of the dwarf race, and can be identified easily by their tan skin as many hail from trade & port city's along the coast. Most of their heritage comes from the Mountain clans but whereas the Mountain dwarves create the the goods, the Gold dwarf clans are the ones who have long left the Mountains in order to sell and distribute them across the land.

feats.d: Your maximum carry weight capacity increases by 25 lbs and your Ground Speed is not reduced when wearing Medium or heavy Armor.

When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You gain 1 Exhaustion Points (EP) when you use this feature and this feature can only be used once per Rest.

subs.desc: Gold Dwarves heritage ties back to the mountain clans but has long since branched as policy's and movements have pushed them towards mercantilism. Most of them travel in large Merchant Caravan groups passing through Trade and port cities worth their salt in gold. They pride themselves on individuality and their charisma and wit, to them, a dwarf that can't sell the dagger they made, is a dwarf that didn't deserve to make the dagger in the first place. Gold dwarves are also famously known for their trade relations with Gnomish Craftsmen's and the distribution and selling of their Firearms.
subs.langs: Two additional Languages of your choice

feats.d: You gain proficiency in simple and martial Firearms.

You learn and know the following crafting recipes: 
[color=#b7791f]Hillbrand Ring[/color],

subs.desc: Mountain Dwarves hail from the Gilded halls and stone carved cities build within the mountains themself, each one a craftsmen in their own right.
subs.prof: Choose two Trade Skills of your choice
subs.langs: One additional Language of your choice

feats.d: You gain proficiency in simple and martial Axes and Cudgels.
You learn and know the following crafting recipes: [color=#b7791f]Dwarven Iron Battleaxe[/color], [color=#b7791f]Dwarven Iron Hand Axe[/color]

races.desc: Elves are the pointy eared, tall, and slender people of yore known for their long lifespans that are nearly ten times longer than humans. Elves hail from all over the realm from the High-Elf's (sometimes called Highborn elves) that have long integrated with human Monarchy's and settlements, To the Wood Elves who defend their ancestral forests and grove homelands, and lastly the Dark Elves, who reside in the deep underground in the midnight of their monolithic strongholds and cities.

feats.d: You have an advantage on saving throws against spells or effects that Charm or put you to Sleep.

subs.prof: Stealth, Either Alchemy or Tailoring (your choice)
subs.langs: One additional Language of your choice

feats.d: Your Darkvision has a range of 60 feet, instead of 30
You can blend in with dim areas and hide amongst dark areas, you can take the hide action when in dim or dark areas.

You learn and know the following crafting recipes:
[color=#b7791f]Whisperweave Hood[/color], [color=#b7791f]Whsiperweave Boots[/color], [color=#b7791f]Whisperweave Mantle[/color], [color=#b7791f]Night Brew[/color]

subs.desc: You are a High elf whose lineage traces back to the ancient Highborn elves from a time of magic, innovation, and Warfare. Many High Elves have a high aptitude for Magic and the Arcane Arts with many of them becoming mages and even the ones that don't dabble in magic to a small degree without meaning to.
subs.langs: Two additional Languages of your choice

feats.d:
When you are targeted by a spell or are within its Target Area, you absorb some of its lingering magic and gain 1 Magic Point (MP) after the spell resolves. Once you use this feature, roll a d4. You can’t use it again for that many rounds of combat.

MP gained this way can’t exceed your Max Pool. Any excess is lost.

You can spend 1 Magic Point (MP) to produce one of the following minor magical effects:

[color=#c2410c]Ignite:[/color] you can produce a small flame at one of the ends of your fingertips, the flame ignites organic material such as paper, straw, fabric, etc.
[color=#c2410c]Shout:[/color] You can imbue your voice to make whatever you say auditable enough to hear from up to 60 feet away.
[color=#c2410c]Mend:[/color] A small tear in cloth, a crack in glass, or a snapped string mends itself over the course of a minute.
[color=#c2410c]Clean:[/color] you can wave your hand and speak a simple arcane word and cleaned dirt, rust, or stains out of your equipment or clothing.
Choose a Basic Alchemy crafting recipe, you learn that recipe.

subs.desc: You are a Wood Elf that hails from the deep forests, groves, and Timber Heartlands that your people call home. Where as high-elves chose to move away from typical values and beliefs, trading clans for innovation and expansion, Wood-elves pride themselves on their heritage, clan, and traditions being fiercely loyal to their community. Many wood-elves that leave their community usually do so out of loss, necessity, or a mission of grave importance. Many wood-elf's integrating into new places and city's for the first time can come off as awkward, credulous, or slow on the uptake when it comes to things like sarcasm or unliteral social demeanors and jokes.
subs.langs: One additional Language of your choice

feats.d: Your Ground movement speed is 35ft.

Falling damage you take
from falling 20ft or less is halved.
You learn and know the following crafting recipes: [color=#b7791f]Livingwood Quarterstaff[/color], [color=#b7791f]Livingwood Shortbow[/color]

races.desc: Humans are the most common and most diverse tall race in the realm. They are socially multidimensional and highly adaptive. Human's live in nearly every region of the world and Align themselves to unique and personal ideals.
races.asi: +1 to two different ability scores of your choice
races.prof: Choose any three skill proficiencies of your choice
races.langs: Common, One additional Language of your choice

feats.d: You gain proficiency in simple Blades, Swords, and Polearms and Light Armor.
Your maximum carry weight capacity increases by 25 lbs.

races.desc: Orcs are a broad-shouldered, heavy-boned people known across the realm for their impressive strength, their endurance and their unshakable loyalty to clan. Their lower tusks, heavy brows and powerful frames make them easy to recognize, and few races can match them in a contest of raw might. Orc clans are spread across the realm, but most trace their roots to one of two paths. The Ashblood Orcs hold the Ash Fields, guarding their territory from Black Iron fortresses and outposts. The Warrenborn Orcs left the old clan ways behind to build new lives alongside humans, goblins and hobgoblins in the crowded Warren settlements.
races.langs: Orcish, One Additional Language of your choice

subs.desc:
The Ashblood Orcs are the clans of the Ash Fields, a wide, smoldering expanse of grey earth, cinder plains and scorched ridgelines where little grows and nothing comes easy. Their skin ranges from ash grey to a pale, bone white, as though the Fields themselves had marked them. The Ashblood Clans live in stark outposts and great Black Iron fortresses raised from the dark ore found beneath the ash, and every clan defends its territory with fierce, unyielding pride.

Ashblood society is built around the warband. Each clan is led by its strongest and most proven warriors, and every member, from smith to scout, is expected to stand for the clan when the war horns sound. Borders between clans are marked, watched and fiercely contested, and an outsider who crosses one without leave is treated as a challenge to be answered. Within a clan, though, the Ashbloods are fiercely loyal. Debts are remembered, oaths are kept, and no one is left behind on the field.

The Ashblood are best known for their Black Iron. It is a heavy, dark metal smelted in the fortress forges and worked into weapons and armor that are rough, brutal and built to last. To the Ashblood, a Black Iron blade isn’t meant to be beautiful. It’s meant to be honest, and it should still be cutting long after the fight has ended.

feats.d: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon’s damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You gain 1 Exhaustion Points (EP) when you use this feature and this feature can only be used once per Rest.
Your maximum carry weight capacity increases by 25 lbs and your Ground Speed is not reduced when wearing Medium or heavy Armor.
